name: Position Effect 2 Code
definition: Indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position.

OPEN.name: Open Position
OPEN.definition: Position after the trade the position should be open.

CLOS.name: Close Position
CLOS.definition: Position after the trade the position should be closed.

ROLL.name: Rolled
ROLL.definition: Results in a position obtained in a security previously held, sold and repurchased.

FIFO.name: Fifo
FIFO.definition: First in, first out. Results in a position obtained after having sold in priority the securities bought chronologically.

CLOA.name: Close Account
CLOA.definition: Trade relates to a closure of an account.
